import numpy as np, math
from PIL import Image
a=np.array(Image.open('obs_0111.png').convert('RGB')).astype(int)
R,G,B=a[:,:,0],a[:,:,1],a[:,:,2]
cx,cy,h=0.549,2.258,0.0
F=(math.sin(math.radians(h)),math.cos(math.radians(h)))
Rt=(math.cos(math.radians(h)),-math.sin(math.radians(h)))
def bp(u,v,z=0.0):
    D=(1.55-z)*256./(v-256.); L=D*(u-256)/256.
    return round(cx+D*F[0]+L*Rt[0],3), round(cy+D*F[1]+L*Rt[1],3)
def rep(name,mask,lo=0,hi=512,vmin=258):
    ys,xs=np.nonzero(mask)
    if not len(xs): print(name,'EMPTY'); return
    k=(xs>=lo)&(xs<hi)
    if not k.sum(): print(name,'EMPTY'); return
    print(name,'u',xs[k].min(),xs[k].max(),'v',ys[k].min(),ys[k].max(),'n',int(k.sum()))
    out=[]
    for u in range(xs[k].min(),xs[k].max()+1):
        c=np.nonzero(mask[:,u])[0]
        c=c[c>vmin]
        if len(c): out.append((u,int(c.max())))
    if out:
        vs=[o[1] for o in out]
        print('  bottom v range',min(vs),max(vs))
        for u,v in out[::max(1,len(out)//8)]: print('   ',u,v,bp(u,v))
    return out
# gray/blue-gray sofa
gy=(abs(R-G)<26)&(abs(G-B)<40)&(B>=R-10)&(R>85)&(R<175)&(B<195)
rep('SOFA-gray',gy,300,512)
# dark legs / lamp pole & base (dark gray)
dk=(R<110)&(G<115)&(B<125)&(abs(R-B)<40)
rep('DARK-left',dk,0,200)
# brown stool top
br=(R>90)&(R<200)&((R-B)>45)&(G<R-20)
rep('BROWN-stool',br,90,200)
# green leaves
gr=(G>R+25)&(G>B+25)&(G>70)
rep('GREEN',gr,350,512)
EOF
